emerging_other_note: Tickets matching no rule stay here. A weekly review trigger fires when this theme exceeds 15% of the week or grows >3pp WoW — the taxonomy-freeze escape hatch (D8).
adjudication_note: Account & Help vs Product Enquiry both cover compatibility questions: pre-purchase 'will this work with X' goes to Product Enquiry; post-purchase setup/pairing-with-X failures go to Account & Help. Phase 5 labels follow this rule.

themes.definition: Devices will not pair, connect, or stay connected over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi.
themes.name: Connectivity & Pairing

themes.definition: Battery drains fast, buds/case will not charge, or charging behavior is abnormal.
themes.name: Charging & Battery

themes.definition: No audio, one-sided audio, distortion, hiss, mic failures, or call-quality complaints.
themes.name: Audio Quality & Mic

themes.definition: Vireo app crashes, will not open, firmware update stuck/failed, or feature malfunction after update.
themes.name: App & Firmware

themes.definition: Late, missing, damaged, or wrong-item deliveries; tracking and courier failures.
themes.name: Delivery & Shipping

themes.definition: Return pickup delays/failures, refund delays or missing refunds, reshipment issues.
themes.name: Returns & Refunds

themes.definition: Double charges, failed payments with debit, coupon/price mismatches, invoice/GST requests.
themes.name: Billing & Payments

themes.definition: Warranty claims, RMA status, repair delays, and out-of-warranty hardware faults.
themes.name: Warranty & Repair

themes.definition: Login/OTP failures, account access, address/pincode changes, pre-purchase compatibility questions.
themes.name: Account & Help

themes.definition: Compatibility and usage questions answerable from product specs (not defects).
themes.name: Product Enquiry

themes.definition: Any complaint matching no other theme after keyword + taxonomy mapping.
themes.name: Other / Unclassified
